sources.notes: Representation-aligned tactile grounding applies future-touch supervision at intermediate action-expert features.
HapticVLA distills training-time tactile information into a vision/state policy that does not require touch at deployment.
OmniVTA combines a two-stream visuo-tactile world model with a contact-aware policy and a 60 Hz tactile reflex controller.
RCT exposes contact-sequence leakage and held-out-material failure in touch-vision-language representation learning.

terms.why: Names where future-touch supervision should enter a VLA.
Names training-time touch transfer to a sensor-light deployment policy.
Names joint prediction of contact dynamics and visual evolution.
Names a leakage-resistant evaluation unit for tactile representation datasets.
